t: Energy Cards are used to send Energy between inventories, such as machines and batteries.$(br2)Energy cards have some slightly different mechanics from the other cards, and will be documentated in the following pages.
能量卡用于在不同存储空间之间传输能量，如机器和电池。$(br2)能量卡的机制和其他几种物流卡略有不同，详细介绍可见后页。

Unlike Item/Fluid cards that require overclockers to operate faster than once every 20 ticks, Energy Cards can operate every tick by default.$(br2)Overclockers can't go into Energy cards. Energy cards always operate at 1,000,000 FE/tick max. This can be reduced if you wish.
物品卡和流体卡需要超频器才能每 20 刻内运行多次，能量卡则不同，它在默认情况下就能每刻都运行。$(br2)能量卡不接受超频器，且能一直以最大 1,000,000FE/tick 的速度运作。如有需求可以降低此上限。

Energy cards also have an 'Energy Limit %' setting -- By default, on insert/stock modes this is 100%, and on extract modes this is 0%. On insert/stock mode it specifies how much to fill up the specified energy acceptor. $(br2)For example: If the block can hold 1,000,000 FE, and you specify 50%, it will only fill up to 500,000FE.
能量卡有一个“能量限制（%）”设置⸺默认情况下，处于输入或存储模式时为 100%，而处于提取模式时为 0%。处于输入或存储模式时，该值代表输入的能量占总存量的最大占比。$(br2)例如：若毗邻方块最多能存有 1,000,000FE，将该值设为 50%，则节点最多会将其充能至 500,000FE。

In extract mode, this designates what percent should be left behind.$(br2)For example: If you are extracting FE from an energy cell that can hold 1,000,000FE, and specify a limit of 25%, it will not extract below 250,000 FE.
处于提取模式时，该值代表余下的能量占比。$(br2)例如：若从能存有 1,000,000FE 的能量单元中提取能量，将该值设为 25%，则节点不会在能量低于或等于 250,000FE 时继续提取。

Technical Note: The Forge Energy system supports energy storage up to MAX_INT which is approximately 2.14 billion FE. If you are using a mod like Draconic Evolution or Mekanism, their storage cells can store greater than this amount by 'hacking' how Forge Energy works. As a result, this % indicator will not work on storage cells greater than 2.14 billion FE. Sorry! :)
技术性注释：FE 能量系统支持某一能量单元存有最多 MAX_INT FE（大约 21.4 亿 FE）。若装有类似龙之进化（Draconic Evolution）和通用机械（Mekanism）的模组，它们会“修改”FE 系统的工作方式，以此让自己的能量单元可存有大于该值的能量。这就导致该数值对可存有大于 21.4 亿 FE 的能量单元无效。抱歉！:)
